messages.subject: birth death models
parts:
Hi INLA Team,
I am interested in fitting birth-death models using INLA. 
I wanted to know whether it may be possible to have some guidance on how to get started. In my application I have counts on the terminal nodes of a phylogenetic tree. I want to fit the data into a BD model an estimate the birth and dead rates. I am interested in a couple of questions: a) whether groups of branches on the tree differ on their parameter values, and b) estimating the parameters for each branch on the tree. This model is of the kind described on "Streamlining and Large Ancestral Genomes in Archaea Inferred with a Phylogenetic Birth-and-Death Model".
Let me know if you think this may be possible and I can put together some examples files if you need them to construct and some example code.

Best and thanks in advance,
Inti Pedroso
